title: Text Chunker
description:
A text chunking component that splits documents into smaller, semantically coherent 
chunks for downstream processing such as embedding, retrieval, and LLM-based generation. 
Provides two strategies the engine does not otherwise have: sentence-boundary splitting 
with no third-party dependencies, and token-based splitting using the real tiktoken BPE 
tokenizer (not a byte-length estimate). Both support configurable chunk size and overlap, 
and emit start/end character offsets per chunk. For recursive character splitting use the 
General Text (preprocessor_langchain) node, which already provides it.

input.description:
Receives documents and splits them into smaller chunks using the 
configured chunking strategy. Each chunk is emitted as a separate 
document with metadata tracking its position within the original.

output.description:
Produces one document per chunk, with chunkId and parentId 
metadata for downstream reassembly.
